commands.name: search-parks
commands.summary: Find National Park Service units, filtered by state, activity or topic, or sorted by distance from a lat/lng point

commands.name: search-parks-by-name
commands.summary: Search parks by name or keyword (e.g. 'Yosemite') and get park codes, descriptions and coordinates

commands.name: list-park-filters
commands.summary: List all filter values for search-parks: topic ids, activity ids, state codes, and every park code with its name

commands.name: list-related-subjects
commands.summary: Get NPS subject/topic pages related to a set of activity and topic ids, with the park codes linked to each

commands.name: get-park
commands.summary: Get a park's overview (schema.org linked data): description, phone, address, visitor centers and opening hours

commands.name: get-park-facilities
commands.summary: Get a park's structured operational data: addresses plus parking lots with capacity, live status, schedules and predicted occupancy

commands.name: get-park-alerts
commands.summary: Get current alerts for one park: closures, road closures, cautions and information

commands.name: list-nps-alerts
commands.summary: List the nationwide sitewide alerts for all parks (closures, dangers, information) with park and state

commands.name: get-park-banner-image
commands.summary: Get a park's banner photo: image path, credit, alt text and crops

commands.name: search-multimedia
commands.summary: Search NPS photos, videos, audio and webcams by keyword, with optional Solr filter (type, park) and sort

commands.name: search-articles
commands.summary: Search NPS articles, people and places pages by keyword (returns /articles/... URLs)

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Read an NPS article page by slug (/articles/{slug}.htm)

commands.name: get-photo
commands.summary: Get NPGallery photo/asset metadata: title, description, credit/copyright, license, dimensions and EXIF

commands.name: get-video-captions
commands.summary: Download the WebVTT closed-caption transcript of an NPS video

commands.name: geocode-suggest
commands.summary: Get place suggestions for a location string, with magicKeys to resolve into coordinates (US only)

commands.name: geocode-location
commands.summary: Resolve a geocode-suggest magicKey into lat/lng (location.y / location.x) for search-parks

commands.name: get-weather-point
commands.summary: Look up the NWS forecast grid (office, gridX, gridY), nearest city, time zone and sunrise/sunset for a lat/lng

commands.name: get-weather-forecast
commands.summary: Get the 7-day NWS forecast periods for a grid point (from get-weather-point)

commands.name: get-weather-alerts
commands.summary: Get active NWS watches, warnings and advisories, optionally limited to a lat,lng point (e.g. a park location) or a state/area code

commands.name: get-weather-observation
commands.summary: Get the latest observed conditions (temperature, wind, etc.) from an NWS weather station
